title: vm-slots
description: The macOS guest slots of this Mac: the slots in force, each holder, each waiter in order, contention and the state of the observations of tart. Every time is in seconds since the Unix epoch.

requested_by.description: Who asked, or null when no request of this run of the app made the holder.

pid.description: The process id of the client. The app reads it from the kernel.

cwd.description: The working directory that the client stated. Null for an older testanyware.

slots.description: The value of macos_slots in force. 0 on a host without the app.

limit.description: The limit of Apple: 2. 0 on a host without the app.

since.description: The admission of a holder that the app admitted. For any other holder, the moment when the app first noted it.

deadline.description: The end of the wait. Null for a waiter without a bound.

contention.description: Null while contention does not hold. In contention, the last refusal by the framework.

observed_at.description: The last answer of tart. Null before the first answer.

unanswered_since.description: The first failed observation after the last answer. Null while tart answers.
